name: Veiled
source:
It has been one year since the incident. One endlessly long year looking for the truth.

You know your child is alive. All the answers must be out there...

[From [url=https://grouflon.itch.io/veiled]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
距离那起事件已经过去整整一年了。在追寻真相中度过的这一年，漫长得仿佛没有尽头。

你深知自己的孩子还活着。所有的答案，一定就藏在外面的某个角落……

[摘自[url=https://grouflon.itch.io/veiled]itch.io[/url]]
